evidence.title: Lightspark | The API for money: accounts, payments, cards

name: Lightspark
summary: Payments API for launching global accounts, payouts, cards and stablecoins under your brand, with local rails in 65+ countries.
description: Lightspark is infrastructure for moving money worldwide: one API to launch branded global dollar accounts, send payouts, accept pay-ins, issue Visa cards and move between fiat and stablecoins. Products span Global Accounts, payments, accounts and cards, and DeFi and trading, with docs, sandbox and playground for developers; the platform API is named Grid.
contains: one integration, local rails in 65+ countries (Pix, UPI, SPEI, SEPA) and 175M+ Visa merchant locations
products: global accounts, payouts, pay-ins, cards, wallets, stablecoin issuance, swaps, agentic payments
2-5 days to go live; seconds median settlement
docs, sandbox and playground; platform API named Grid
customers include Coinbase, SoFi, Nubank, Revolut and Bitso
SOC 2 certified; first MiCA CASP and EMI license in Estonia
